summary.text: Gary Friedmann is a Democratic state representative who has represented Maine House District 14 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes work in nonprofit development.

paragraphs.text: Friedmann's career experience includes working in nonprofit development.
He took office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
